[[Princess Leifah]] can be found standing next to [[Lyssa]]'s shrine in the center of the [[Halls of Chokhin]].

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}} (inside the [[Halls of Chokhin]])

==Dialogue==
:''"I grow weary of the suitors my father thrusts upon me. [[Vabbi]]an royalty is concerned with wealth and status. My suitors view me as a prized possession to be bought and displayed. Am I doomed to such insignificance?"''
